_meta.title: H3 FastVideo (FH3) - 4-step distill, single-pass T2V+audio
_meta.status: NEW / experimental - does not touch any existing workflow
_meta.what: MiniMax H3 sampled through the FastVideo lab's distilled 'FastH3' checkpoint (VSA / DataFree, 4-step, fine-tuned from base H3). Plain text-to-video with joint audio, no reference images, no turbo LoRA - the checkpoint already carries the step distillation. Run at 8 sampling steps (FastVideo's own recommendation; 4 works but 8 is cleaner).
_meta.requires_download: models/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_fastvideo_vsa_datafree_1300step_4step_int8_convrot.safetensors  (~22 GB, from huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3-experimental). NOT on this box yet - the graph will error on UNETLoader until it is placed there. Model card: huggingface.co/FastVideo/FastVideo-FastH3-4-step-Preview-v1-VSA-DataFree
_meta.vs_current_pipeline: The v22 CCTV pipeline is ref2va (4 reference plates for identity/set). This is T2V-only: consistency comes entirely from the written prompt, not from reference images. Use it for speed / concepting / prompt-only storytelling, not for the locked-character short.
_meta.knobs: node 20 prompt (integrated_multimodal_description / overall_soundscape / non_diegetic_music, with 00:0X markers) ; node 20 + graph width/height (768x1344 here ~1.03 MP; drop to ~640x1152 for FastVideo's ~30 s / 5 s-clip figure) ; node 20 length (17k+5 grid: 124=5.17s, 175=7.29s, 362=15.08s) ; node 24 steps (8; try 4 for max speed) ; node 8 shift_video (12.0 core default; sweep 6-12 if motion looks over/under-shifted).
_meta.optional: add a LoraLoaderModelOnly(h3-realism-people-t2v-i2v-r2v.safetensors @0.9) between node 1 and node 7 if skin/faces look plasticky - untested in combination with this distill, so A/B it.
_meta.format: API-format graph. Drag onto the ComfyUI canvas (0.31.0 offers to import) or Workflow > Open.

inputs.prompt: integrated_multimodal_description: Cinematic live-action, locked-off wide, blue-hour city rooftop. A lone figure in a long dark coat stands at the parapet with their back to camera, hair and coat-hem stirring in the wind. At 00:02 they lift their head to look across the skyline. At 00:04 a flock of birds scatters off a nearby ledge and crosses the frame left to right. The camera holds completely still on a tripod, deep focus, faint handheld-free micro-vibration only. overall_soundscape: steady wind across the mic, distant traffic hum far below, the soft flutter and calls of the birds as they pass, a loose tarp snapping somewhere off-frame. non_diegetic_music: a slow sustained synth pad in a minor key, one low piano note every few seconds, no percussion, gently swelling toward the end.
